title: Trump administration proposes six-figure price tag for new H-1B visas
summary: The Department of Homeland Security proposed making the $103,265 H-1B visa fee permanent after a federal judge blocked the temporary charge.

title: Syria off US terror blacklist after nearly 50 years as Trump admin clears investment hurdle
summary: The United States formally removed Syria from its state sponsors of terrorism list after Marco Rubio authorized the rescission and delisted HTS.

title: Trump admin eyes historic mass visa revocation targeting up to 200K asylum seekers: report
summary: The Trump administration is reportedly preparing to revoke B1 and B2 visas held by up to 200,000 foreigners who applied for asylum in the United States.

title: Trump scores Supreme Court win on mail-in voting restrictions before midterms
summary: The Supreme Court’s order clears the Trump administration to immediately enforce revised mail-ballot restrictions in 23 states ahead of November’s midterms.

title: Trump administration touts ‘hard reset’ for American schools, vows to put parents ‘back in charge’
summary: The president, who was joined by Education Secretary Linda McMahon, said his education agenda will expand school choice, boost support for families and give parents a greater say in their children’s education.

title: Schiff attack on Trump’s DC IndyCar race backfires after driver points out contradiction
summary: IndyCar driver Graham Rahal fired back at Adam Schiff's claim that Trump's Washington race wasted taxpayer money, noting Penske privately funded it.

title: Trump wants cheaper beef. Republicans in key races warn his plan goes too far
summary: Senate Republicans, including Tom Cotton and Tim Sheehy, push back on Trump's plan to import 300,000 metric tons of foreign ground beef to lower prices.

title: Jeffries' reported meeting with Kushner about possible Trump cooperation draws left-wing backlash
summary: House Minority Leader Hakeem Jeffries, a New York Democrat, met with President Donald Trump's son-in-law Jared Kushner, reports indicate.

title: Vulnerable GOP senator breaks with Trump on 2 key issues as Vance makes stop without her
summary: Susan Collins skips JD Vance's Maine visit while opposing Trump's 50% tariffs on Canada and new postal service rules restricting mail-in voting.

title: Arizona grandpa to undergo amputation after collapsing on scorching sidewalk
summary: A 72-year-old man collapsed on a 120-degree sidewalk in Arizona and suffered severe burns that will require above-knee amputation of his leg.
